#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main()
{
	std::string s;
	std::cin>>s;

	s.replace(s.find("at",1),2,"@");

	while(true)
	{
		auto it = s.find("dot",1);
		if(it == s.npos || it > s.length() - 4)
			break;
		s.replace(it,3,".");
	}

	std::cout << s;

	return 0;
}
